faq.a: Seven tabs sharing one local dataset: a Syllabus tracker covering Prelims GS and CSAT plus all four Mains GS papers and Essay as nested checklists; an Answer Writing editor with 150/250-word limits and a timer; dated Current Affairs notes with tags; a Revision checklist of standard books per subject; a Study Timer that logs minutes by subject with a weekly chart; Polity Flashcards; and a Backup tab for JSON export/import.

faq.q: How does the answer-writing timer and word count work?
faq.a: Pick a 150 or 250 word limit and press Start Timer; it counts up and turns red past the suggested maximum (7 minutes for 150 words, 10 for 250). The live word counter turns amber at 80% of the limit and red once you exceed it. Saved answers store the question, text, word count, limit, and date, and can be expanded or deleted later.

faq.q: How is the study streak and timer total calculated?
faq.a: The streak increments once per calendar day you use the hub (reset to 1 if you miss a day), using local date rather than UTC so a late-night session after midnight IST still counts correctly. The Study Timer logs each session's minutes under the day, drawing a 7-day bar chart, and the dashboard 'Hours' stat sums all logged minutes across every day divided by 60.

faq.q: Is any of my data on a server, and can I move it between devices?
faq.a: No server — everything is saved in your browser (main data under upsc_bundle_v2, streak under upsc_streak). To move or back up, use the Backup tab's 'Export All Data', which writes a dated JSON of your syllabus progress, saved answers, current affairs notes, revision ticks, and timer logs. Import reads that JSON back. The flashcards and syllabus content themselves are built-in.
